proof:
set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
by
  classical
  intro N w F hN hw hF hFN p hp hAw hBw
  let A := M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedA N p
  let B := M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedB N p
  let WA := M5.PhysicalRecovery.availableA N p
  let WB := M5.PhysicalRecovery.availableB N p
  have hs := M5.PhysicalRecovery.state_domains N p hN hp
  simp only [M5.PhysicalRecovery.StateOK] at hs
  have hA : A ⊆ Finset.range N := by
    dsimp [A]
    aesop
  have hB : B ⊆ Finset.range N := by
    dsimp [B]
    aesop
  have hWA : WA ⊆ Finset.range N := by
    dsimp [WA]
    aesop
  have hWB : WB ⊆ Finset.range N := by
    dsimp [WB]
    aesop
  have hA0 : 0 ∈ A := by
    simp [A, M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedA, M5.PhysicalRecovery.selected]
  have hB0 : 0 ∈ B := by
    simp [B, M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedB, M5.PhysicalRecovery.selected]
  have hdA : Disjoint A WA := by
    dsimp [A, WA]
    aesop
  have hdB : Disjoint B WB := by
    dsimp [B, WB]
    aesop
  have enum (q : List Bool) :
      (∃ f : Fin (M5.PhysicalRecovery.decisionCount N) → Bool,
        List.ofFn f = q) ↔ q.length = M5.PhysicalRecovery.decisionCount N := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨f, rfl⟩
      simp
    · intro hq
      subst_vars
      exact ⟨q.get, List.ofFn_get q⟩
  have words (q : List Bool) :
      q ∈ M5.PhysicalRecovery.validWords N w F ↔
        q.length = M5.PhysicalRecovery.decisionCount N ∧
        M5.PhysicalRecovery.ValidSupports N w F
          (M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedA N q)
          (M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedB N q) := by
    simp [M5.PhysicalRecovery.validWords, M5.PhysicalRecovery.wordValid,
      enum, and_assoc, and_left_comm, and_comm]
  let S := (M5.PhysicalRecovery.validWords N w F).filter (fun q => p.IsPrefix q)
  have memS (q : List Bool) : q ∈ S ↔
      q.length = M5.PhysicalRecovery.decisionCount N ∧
      M5.PhysicalRecovery.ValidSupports N w F
        (M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedA N q)
        (M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedB N q) ∧ p.IsPrefix q := by
    simp only [S, Finset.mem_filter, words]
    tauto
  have memC (U V : Finset ℕ) :
      (U, V) ∈ M5.PhysicalRecovery.completionSet N w F p ↔
      U ⊆ WA ∧ V ⊆ WB ∧ U.card = w - A.card ∧ V.card = w - B.card ∧
      M5.Connectivity.supportGcd N (A ∪ U) (B ∪ V) = 1 ∧
      M5.completeSignature (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport (A ∪ U))
        (M5.SupportPolynomial.ofSupport (B ∪ V)) N = F := by
    simp only [M5.PhysicalRecovery.completionSet,
      M5.ConditionalCount.validCompletions, Finset.product_eq_sprod,
      Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_powersetCard]
    dsimp [A, B, WA, WB]
    tauto
  have difference (X Y W : Finset ℕ) (hXY : X ⊆ Y)
      (hYW : Y ⊆ X ∪ W) (hY : Y.card = w) :
      Y \ X ⊆ W ∧ (Y \ X).card = w - X.card ∧ X ∪ (Y \ X) = Y := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx
      have hx' := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hx
      have := Finset.mem_union.mp (hYW hx'.1)
      tauto
    · rw [Finset.card_sdiff hXY, hY]
    · ext x
      simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_sdiff]
      constructor
      · rintro (hx | ⟨hx, _⟩)
        · exact hXY hx
        · exact hx
      · intro hx
        by_cases h : x ∈ X <;> tauto
  have addition (X W U : Finset ℕ) (hX : X ⊆ Finset.range N)
      (hW : W ⊆ Finset.range N) (h0 : 0 ∈ X) (hd : Disjoint X W)
      (hc : X.card ≤ w) (hU : U ⊆ W) (hUc : U.card = w - X.card) :
      X ∪ U ⊆ Finset.range N ∧ 0 ∈ X ∪ U ∧
      (X ∪ U).card = w ∧ (X ∪ U) \ X = U := by
    have hdU : Disjoint X U := hd.mono_right hU
    refine ⟨Finset.union_subset hX (hU.trans hW),
      Finset.mem_union_left U h0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdU, hUc]
      omega
    · ext x
      have hd' := Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdU
      simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_union]
      constructor
      · tauto
      · intro hx
        exact ⟨Or.inr hx, fun h => hd' h hx⟩
  let f : List Bool → Finset ℕ × Finset ℕ := fun q =>
    (M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedA N q \ A,
      M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedB N q \ B)
  let g : Finset ℕ × Finset ℕ → List Bool := fun t =>
    M5.PhysicalRecovery.encode N (A ∪ t.1) (B ∪ t.2)
  have forward (q : List Bool) (hq : q ∈ S) :
      f q ∈ M5.PhysicalRecovery.completionSet N w F p ∧ g (f q) = q := by
    obtain ⟨hql, hqv, hqp⟩ := (memS q).mp hq
    have he := (M5.PhysicalRecovery.prefix_extension N p q hN hp hql).mp hqp
    change A ⊆ M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedA N q ∧
      M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedA N q ⊆ A ∪ WA ∧
      B ⊆ M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedB N q ∧
      M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedB N q ⊆ B ∪ WB at he
    simp only [M5.PhysicalRecovery.ValidSupports] at hqv
    have hqcA : (M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedA N q).card = w := by tauto
    have hqcB : (M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedB N q).card = w := by tauto
    have da := difference A _ WA he.1 he.2.1 hqcA
    have db := difference B _ WB he.2.2.1 he.2.2.2 hqcB
    constructor
    · apply (memC _ _).mpr
      refine ⟨da.1, db.1, da.2.1, db.2.1, ?_⟩
      rw [da.2.2, db.2.2]
      tauto
    · dsimp [g, f]
      rw [da.2.2, db.2.2]
      exact M5.PhysicalRecovery.encode_decode N q hN hql
  have backward (t : Finset ℕ × Finset ℕ)
      (ht : t ∈ M5.PhysicalRecovery.completionSet N w F p) :
      g t ∈ S ∧ f (g t) = t := by
    rcases t with ⟨U, V⟩
    obtain ⟨hU, hV, hcU, hcV, hgcd, hsig⟩ := (memC U V).mp ht
    have ha := addition A WA U hA hWA hA0 hdA hAw hU hcU
    have hb := addition B WB V hB hWB hB0 hdB hBw hV hcV
    have hdec := M5.PhysicalRecovery.decode_encode N (A ∪ U) (B ∪ V)
      hN ha.1 hb.1 ha.2.1 hb.2.1
    have hlen : (g (U, V)).length = M5.PhysicalRecovery.decisionCount N := by
      simp [g, M5.PhysicalRecovery.encode]
    have hda : M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedA N (g (U, V)) = A ∪ U := hdec.1
    have hdb : M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedB N (g (U, V)) = B ∪ V := hdec.2
    constructor
    · apply (memS _).mpr
      refine ⟨hlen, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hda, hdb]
        simp only [M5.PhysicalRecovery.ValidSupports]
        tauto
      · apply (M5.PhysicalRecovery.prefix_extension N p (g (U, V)) hN hp hlen).mpr
        change A ⊆ M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedA N (g (U, V)) ∧
          M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedA N (g (U, V)) ⊆ A ∪ WA ∧
          B ⊆ M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedB N (g (U, V)) ∧
          M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedB N (g (U, V)) ⊆ B ∪ WB
        rw [hda, hdb]
        exact ⟨Finset.subset_union_left, Finset.union_subset_union_right hU,
          Finset.subset_union_left, Finset.union_subset_union_right hV⟩
    · change (M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedA N (g (U, V)) \ A,
        M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedB N (g (U, V)) \ B) = (U, V)
      rw [hda, hdb, ha.2.2.2, hb.2.2.2]
  have hc : S.card = (M5.PhysicalRecovery.completionSet N w F p).card := by
    apply Finset.card_bij (fun q _ => f q)
    · intro q hq
      exact (forward q hq).1
    · intro q hq r hr he
      calc
        q = g (f q) := (forward q hq).2.symm
        _ = g (f r) := congrArg g he
        _ = r := (forward r hr).2
    · intro t ht
      exact ⟨g t, (backward t ht).1, (backward t ht).2⟩
  change (S.card : ℤ) = ((M5.PhysicalRecovery.completionSet N w F p).card : ℤ)
  exact congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℤ)) hc
